validation.limitations: Exact stored BS2 ordinal-zero target unions, context memberships and guide-positive circles were independently checked against the frozen private fixture and byte-replayed to this PNG. This is one predeclared engineering view with a tissue proxy, not raw OCT, clinical interpretation, population geometry, downstream AUC or retraining evidence.
